mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "centerAnniday" DESC) AS RNUM, TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.CENTER_ID AS "centerId", A.CENTER_ANNIDAY AS "centerAnniday", A.CENTER_ANNISTARTDAY AS "centerAnniStartDay", A.CENTER_ANNIENDDAY AS "centerAnniEndDay", A.START_TIME AS "startTime", A.END_TIME AS "endTime", A.TIME_OVER AS "timeOver", A.BROD_CODE AS "brodCode", B.BROD_NAME AS "brodName" FROM TB_CENTERANNIVERSARY A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BRODSCHEDULE B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND A.CENTER_ID = #{centerId} ) TB ) TA WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{firstIndex} + 1 AND #{firstIndex} + #{recordCountPerPage}
SELECT CENTER_ID, CENTER_ANNISTARTDAY, CENTER_ANNIENDDAY, START_TIME, END_TIME, TIME_OVER, BROD_CODE FROM TB_CENTERANNIVERSARY WHERE CENTER_ANNIDAY = #{centerAnniday}
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_CENTERANNIVERSARY WHERE 1=1 AND CENTER_ID = #{centerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CENTERANNIVERSARY ( CENTER_ANNIDAY, CENTER_ID, CENTER_ANNISTARTDAY, CENTER_ANNIENDDAY, START_TIME, END_TIME, TIME_OVER, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BROD_CODE ) VALUES ( #{centerAnniday}, #{centerId}, #{centerAnniStartDay}, #{centerAnniEndDay}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{timeOver, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brodCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CENTERANNIVERSARY SET CENTER_ID = #{centerId}, CENTER_ANNISTARTDAY = #{centerAnniStartDay}, CENTER_ANNIENDDAY = #{centerAnniEndDay}, START_TIME = #{startTime}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, TIME_OVER = #{timeOver, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BROD_CODE = #{brodCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE CENTER_ANNIDAY = #{centerAnniday}
